item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
This article doesn't rely on previous knowledge from the draft it was inspired by in order to stand on its own. Several members that upvoted it did so simply because the concept of a computer that doesn't understand a thing about computers, as opposed to the Skynet\A.M\HAL 9000 trope, appeals to them.

In no moment direct mention to the author of said draft was made. There is huge difference between turning a conceptual catastrophe into something salvageable and publicly condemning a idea forever like, say, 100-J does, and even that one is but a tribute to bad concepts. Again, no mention to the original authors is made.

Now, if you're implying that some people could be offended by being told that their idea sucks beyond redemption, those people should consider a different website.

I'm sorry, but I just can't upvote an article that was created for the sole purpose of mocking someone else's idea. This is a perfect example of crossing the line from "harsh criticism" and "high standards" to just plain being spiteful. I really hope this doesn't count as malicious downvoting, but I have to downvote this.

I mean, this wasn't even posted to the site- it was put up for review, on the forums, as new members are told to do, and in response a parody was placed on the site for everyone to laugh at forever. Besides being abhorrent, that's almost certainly not going to lead to people putting their work up for review before they post it.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
So… I've made a list, because that's what people do sometimes when they're me commenting on this article.

Pros:

  • Well written
  • Science'd correctly
  • It's a -J

Cons:

  • It's not funny
  • It's the third -J submitted recently making fun of a bad article
    • I downvoted the other two
  • It's stupid humor
    • It's still not funny

It's just… I didn't laugh. There's nothing at all funny about this. There are two sentences in the interview that I may have laughed at if I hadn't seen the joke already in the forum. There's so much time spent building up to the joke, and there's so little payoff. This:

SCP-2029: No, but hear me out. I got a motherboard, right?

Dr. █████████: Yes, of course?

SCP-2029: So that makes me a woman.

Is the only part of the whole thing that is entertaining. That's a whole lot of article for three lines of joke. The other logs try, but there's no humor there. There is not enough joke in this joke.
